continuation: R2-R4 remain the original frozen packages; no efficacy-based task replacement, prompting change, judge replacement or retry is proposed. Their mechanical identities were rechecked, and their generation still needs its own authorization.
cost_observation: More optional input was supplied in every resource arm. Generation time also depends on realized output length, so one deterministic response per arm cannot establish a stable speed/quality tradeoff.

launch_accounting.note: Preserved launcher entrypoint failure is separate from inference and from semantic task outcomes.

layer_conclusions.evaluation: Task-level criterion ceiling and unqualified semantic measurement limit conclusions. Development observations do not qualify their own evaluator or training reward.
layer_conclusions.generator: All requested inputs were delivered and all physical outputs ended at EOS. Seven auxiliary framing observations were recorded across five physical replies; the two uncertain original items occur in one Generic reply. These observations were not turned into new success criteria.
layer_conclusions.representation: RAW and Method both passed fixed observations here, but differ in normative adaptation and token amount. This experiment does not isolate compression semantics.
layer_conclusions.resource: The supplied direct methods cover these tasks at their core communication level. Unknown qualifications, practical outcomes and clinical competence remain unsupported. Direct partial-coverage and entry/stop cases are untested in R1.
layer_conclusions.retrieval: One actual retrieval differed from the direct candidate and had partial coverage. Its reply still met the fixed criteria. Difference from privileged DP is not itself a retrieval failure.

main_finding: No improvement over R0 is established on the frozen task criteria in this development review: R0 passes the twelve original item observations, as do DP-RAW, DP-Method, RET-Method and F-resident. Generic has ten pass and two uncertain item observations. These are unqualified development judgments, not formal scores.
scope: three pre-frozen constructed development tasks, 18 logical arms / 16 physical replies
